evidence.detail: R461 fixes the enclosing rs/a/b/a class as ModelRecolorOverride, constructed from exact definition config keys 'recolor'/'recolors'.
Each inner instance stores one int-set of source face-color ids, one destination-color int[] and one cursor; the parent creates one instance per configured source/destination recolor group.

Its sole public operation returns destinationColors[cursor], increments the cursor and wraps it to zero at array length, providing the deterministic replacement-color cycle used by ModelRecolorOverride.
ModelRecolorOverride looks up the inner group by source face-color id and uses this cycle result as the replacement value written into the Model face-color array.

candidates.note: Descriptive exact-v308 name for the per-recolor-group cyclic destination selector owned exclusively by ModelRecolorOverride.
